name: Written In Ashes
source:
A psychological horror visual novel where every choice pulls you closer to a fate you might not escape. 

A story following Ethan, a teenager who discovers a diary predicting his future with terrifying accuracy. As he investigates, the line between free will and fate begins to collapse...

[From [url=https://staticheartstudio.itch.io/written-in-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部心理恐怖视觉小说，每一个选择都会让你更接近你可能无法逃脱的命运。

故事围绕青少年伊森（Ethan）展开，他发现一本日记以惊人的准确度预测了他的未来。随着他的调查，自由意志和命运之间的界限开始崩溃……

[来自[url=https://staticheartstudio.itch.io/written-in-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
